$comment: Durable-directive detector contract (context pipeline §7.4). Deterministic and high-precision: a sentence counts only with a time/persistence marker AND a target verb AND an imperative-shaped start. Clients embed the lexicon from this file (a generated copy checked against the fixture by the contract test) and run their production detector on each text; output must match `expected` exactly. `label` is the human judgement (is this really a durable directive?); `node scripts/context-contracts-check.mjs` computes per-language precision / recall of `expected` against `label` and fails below 0.95 precision. v2: all 16 languages. zh-Hans / en / ar from v1; the other 13 were written by native-style authors and await a non-author native read (languagesAwaitingReview). Cases with id *_eval_* are a blind set written without seeing the lexicon. propose-v3: output adds lang (the lexicon language that matched) and the top-level suggestionLanguages gate for the fallback suggestion bar.
algorithm: All positions are Unicode code points (not UTF-16 units). trim() strips the code points listed in `whitespace` (Unicode White_Space, the same set as the pipeline's shared trim; U+FEFF is not whitespace) from both ends; nothing else counts as whitespace.
Only the first maxScanCodePoints code points of the text are examined (detection and stylePrefix); the rest is ignored.

Mask: scan left to right; at ``` replace through the next ``` (or to end of text when unclosed); at ` replace through the next ` (unclosed: leave it); at an opener of a quotePairs entry (first entry whose opener matches) replace through the next matching closer (unclosed: leave it). Replaced code points become one space each, except newlines which stay. Length in code points is unchanged.

Split the masked text into sentences: cut after any sentenceEnders code point or newline (U+000A only; U+000D and U+2028 do not split), and after '.' when followed by a whitespace code point or end of text. Each sentence keeps its [start, end) code point range; span = trim(original text in that range). Skip sentences whose span is empty.

Question: skip the sentence when trim(masked) ends with a questionEnders code point, or starts with a questionStarters code point, or — after removing the trailing run of 。！!. code points from trim(masked) and trimming once more — its norm() ends with a questionParticlesAtEnd entry of any language L (substring mode: plain suffix of norm(); word / prefix mode: the padded word form ends with ' ' + wordform(term) + ' ').

norm(s): NFKC; full lowercase of the whole string (Unicode default, no locale); then per code point: drop U+064B–U+065F, U+0670, U+0640 (tatweel) and U+0307 (combining dot above); map أ إ آ ٱ → ا, ى → ي, ة → ه, ı → i, ς → σ. Lexicon terms go through the same norm().

wordform(s) (word and prefix modes): on norm(s), map every code point outside Unicode general categories L*, N*, M* to a space, collapse runs of spaces, then pad with exactly one space each side. wordform(term) is the same without the padding.

Matching a term in language L's mode: substring — norm(term) is a substring of norm(sentence); word — ' ' + wordform(term) + ' ' is a substring of wordform(sentence); prefix — ' ' + wordform(term) is a substring of wordform(sentence) (term starts at a word start, may end inside a word).

starts: drop L's fillers repeatedly from the head (substring mode: head = trim(norm(sentence)); a filler matches as a prefix, then trim; word / prefix mode: head = wordform(sentence); a filler matches as ' ' + wordform(f) + ' ' prefix and is removed keeping one leading space), until no filler matches; then the head must begin with an L starts entry (substring: prefix; word: ' ' + wordform(s) + ' ' prefix; prefix mode: ' ' + wordform(s) prefix).

nearMarkers (per language, optional): each entry {a, b, within} is one extra L marker. Tokens of the sentence: code points of norm(sentence) in substring mode; the words of wordform(sentence) in word / prefix mode. A term occupies consecutive tokens (substring: its norm code points; word: its wordform words, equal; prefix: same, except its last word only has to be a prefix of the token). The entry matches when some a term occupies tokens [i, e) and some b term starts at token s with e <= s <= e + within (b after a, at most `within` tokens in between, same sentence). Implementations mark a-ends and b-starts per token and sweep once: linear in tokens per term, no backtracking.

A sentence is a directive when, for some language L (lexicon key order), it contains an L marker (markers, globalMarkers or a nearMarkers entry), an L verb, no L vetoes term (first-person plans, narration and similar shapes the language lists), and passes L's starts. The first such sentence in text order wins; lang: among the languages under which that sentence qualifies (lexicon key order), the first one that is in suggestionLanguages; when none of them is, the first one (e.g. a mixed en / zh-Hans sentence qualifying under both gets zh-Hans; en / fr gets en).

kind: language if any languageWords of any language match (each term in its own language's mode), else format (formatWords), else style (styleWords or imageStyleWords), else other. scope: global if any globalMarkers of any language match, else conversation.
Output {isDirective:false, lang:null} or {isDirective:true, span, kind, scope, lang} (keys in this order). It never changes anything by itself (§7.4).

suggestionLanguages: the conversation-instruction suggestion bar on paths that cannot carry the propose_memory tool (mode fallback / none) is offered only when detect(text).lang is in this list. Basis: the second blind set (16 languages x 110-120 cases) where only these languages had zero false positives on hard negatives and precision >= 95%. The detector output itself is not gated.

stylePrefix(instructions): over the same masked sentences (questions skipped), keep each sentence whose kind is style AND where some imageStyleWords term (any language) matches; join the kept spans with one space in order, adding whole sentences while the total stays <= imageStylePrefixMax code points; when the first kept sentence alone is longer, take its first imageStylePrefixMax code points and trim. No kept sentence → empty string.
